title: PHPNomad Recipe
description: Schema for PHPNomad scaffolding recipes. Defines a structured pattern that the CLI can apply to a project: files to generate, registrations to perform, and child recipes to compose.

name.description: Recipe identifier. For kit-published recipes, the file's basename within the kit's recipes directory becomes the name segment, paired with the kit's vendor (e.g., phpnomad/datastore).

description.description: Free-text description of what the recipe does.

summary.description: One-line description used in list views and quick scans. Keep under 100 characters.

problem.description: User-facing statement of the problem this recipe solves, framed in the user's voice (e.g., 'You have a recurring entity that needs persistent storage'). Different from description, which describes the recipe; problem describes the user's situation.

appliesWhen.description: Match signals. Free-text conditions under which this is the right pattern. AI agents use these to map user intent to recipes.

avoidWhen.description: Anti-patterns. Free-text conditions under which this recipe should NOT be used. Prevents wrong matches.

synonyms.description: Vocabulary translations keyed by domain (e.g., 'wordpress', 'general', 'laravel'). Each domain maps to an array of terms users in that domain typically use for the concept this recipe encodes.

examples.description: Sample user intents that should match this recipe (e.g., 'I need to track customer orders'). Used by AI agents for calibration and by validation tooling as test fixtures.

tags.description: Filterable axes for grouping and narrowing the recipe search space (e.g., 'data', 'wordpress', 'crud').

kind.description: Recipe kind. 'scaffolding' produces files and registrations. 'advisory' is pure pattern guidance with no scaffolding. 'composite' bundles other recipes without adding files of its own.

tradeoffs.description: Free-text description of what applying this pattern costs (e.g., 'Adds three files plus a DI binding; couples the entity to the data layer'). Helps AI agents and humans evaluate fit.

relatedPatterns.description: Pointers to related recipes. Used by AI agents to plan multi-step work and present alternatives.

relationship.description: Nature of the relationship (e.g., 'often-paired', 'alternative-to', 'implements-interface-of', 'data-shape-companion'). Free-text, AI-readable.

stability.description: Maturity of the recipe. AI agents prefer stable patterns and warn on deprecated.

outputs.description: Human-readable list of what the recipe produces after running (e.g., 'A {name}Datastore class', 'A DI binding for {name}DatastoreInterface'). Helps AI agents explain the proposed change before applying it.

postApply.description: Typical follow-up steps the user should take after the recipe is applied (e.g., 'Implement TODO methods in {name}Datastore.php', 'Register a controller that uses this datastore'). Helps AI agents plan multi-step work.

vars.description: Named variables the recipe requires from the caller. Keys become placeholder names usable as {{name}} inside paths, templates, and registration fields.

type.description: Var type. Currently informational only; the engine treats all vars as strings during substitution.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the var represents.

example.description: Sample value for the var, used in documentation and AI prompts.

aiHint.description: Guidance written specifically for an AI agent deciding what value to pass for this var (e.g., 'Use the singular form of the entity, PascalCase, no Model/Entity suffix').

requires.description: Preflight requirements that must be satisfied before the recipe can run.

type.description: Requirement type. Currently 'binding' (a DI binding must already exist in the project).

value.description: Requirement value. For 'binding', the FQCN of the required interface.

files.description: Files the recipe creates. Paths and template names support {{var}} placeholders.

path.description: Project-relative path where the file is written. Supports {{var}} placeholders.

template.description: Template name (without .php.tpl suffix). Resolved relative to the recipe's origin kit.

vars.description: File-specific vars, merged with the recipe's vars when rendering this file's template.

registrations.description: Registrations performed against an initializer after files are written. The CLI mutates the initializer's AST to add or extend Has* contributions.

initializer.description: FQCN of the initializer class to mutate. Supports {{var}} placeholders.

method.description: Method on the initializer to extend (e.g., getClassDefinitions, getListeners).

interface.description: Has* interface that backs the method (e.g., PHPNomad\Loader\Interfaces\HasClassDefinitions). Added to the initializer if missing.

type.description: Shape of the registration. 'map' produces key=>value pairs; 'list' produces a flat array of values.

key.description: Map key when type=map. Supports {{var}} placeholders.

value.description: Map value (for type=map) or list entry (for type=list). Supports {{var}} placeholders.

recipes.description: Child recipe references. Children execute before this recipe's files and registrations, with parent vars flowing down as defaults.

recipe.description: Recipe identifier. Either a kit-published name (vendor/recipe) or a project-local name.

vars.description: Var overrides for the child recipe. Override values may reference parent vars via {{var}} placeholders.
